Task: Conduct a live demo of your bot
Due

In class on Tuesday, November 25th.

Deliverables

During your 10 minute slot, show off what your bot (and web page) can do.

Turn In

no artifact -- just be present and prepared. The full group should expect to stand up front or otherwise be involved.

1	I'll determine an order for presentation; you'll determine how to present the work.

3	To avoid awkwardness around switching laptops, the podium computer will drive the projector. However, you will present from your own computer. To accomplish this, all presenting laptops will join a Zoom room and screenshare to present.

4	We'll allow time for questions / clarifications after the presentation.
